newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq asks U.N. to pressure Ankara to end incursion.
newsitem.headline: Iraq asks U.N. to pressure Ankara to end incursion.

text.p: Iraq has asked the United Nations to exert pressure on Ankara to reconsider its "aggressive policies" in northern Iraq, newspapers said on Tuesday.

They said Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf sent letters to both the U.N. Secretary-General and president of the U.N. Security Council urging them "to interfere with Turkey to reconsider its hostile policies with regard to the situation in northern Iraq."
Several thousand Turkish troops, backed by tanks and heavy artillery, have pushed into northern Iraq since Wednesday in a foray against PKK elements hiding in the mountainous region.
"Iraq holds the Turkish government fully responsible for these aggressive actions inside Iraqi territories along with all the consequences regardless of the pretexts it mentions," one newspaper said.
The papers said the minister stressed that the Turkish sweep into northern Iraq "will destabilise the region as a whole."
